mechanism: Verapamil inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of prochlorperazine, increasing its plasma concentration and risk of adverse effects; both drugs have negative inotropic and QT-prolonging properties.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, hypotension, arrhythmias); consider dose reduction of prochlorperazine or alternative antiemetic; ECG monitoring recommended.
